note: The commit every kernel here is proved against. scripts/bend-checkout.mjs fetches it; spec/build-kernel.ts and spec/laws-check.ts refuse a checkout at any other commit. Upstream is a single force-pushed commit, so the house mirror is the fetch that survives the next force-push; move the pin by re-cloning, re-running every PROOF, and pushing the new commit to the mirror under a new tag.
